segment.source: Renders where the figures on a page come from: a short paragraph on how they were collected and label-value pairs for period, sample, method and source, with a link to the full data. Use it for: the small print under a survey result, provenance beneath a report band, licence and vintage of open data, the method box of a study page. Prefer 'Captioned Data Table' when the numbers themselves belong in the element, and 'Figures List' when the pairs are results rather than method.
